changelog: REQUIRES apworld v1.2.0 - on an older apworld the logic will be wrong
Added the Archipelago Star: the machine, the 6 Archipelago Spheres, and both assemble checks
Added AP Patch tracking - up to 200 checks, shown to match however many your seed rolled
Ability challenges (Sword, Sleep, Wing, Needle, Tornado) now require a course the ability can actually be obtained on, or a copy-panel course instead of Inhale
Fixed every Archipelago check needing Inhale and every Stadium check needing Charge - those rules were wrongly on the mode itself instead of the individual checks
Box-break checks now also require something able to spawn inside that box colour
Assemble and VS KING DEDEDE checks now account for goal-held keys on ungated seeds
Added the missing Quick Spin and Charge requirements on three checks
Fixed "Get over 18 different types of items!" showing as in logic from the start - it had no requirement at all, and now needs 19 of the 21 Top Ride item types
Step-boom and Who? Paint are now tracked and shown - Step-boom was in the pack under the wrong name (Party Bomb) and Who? Paint was missing entirely
Top Ride item-count checks now count all 21 item types instead of 19
Swallow Sword Knight now requires one of the six courses the enemy actually appears on - it was reachable with only Beanstalk Park unlocked
Fire, Bomb, Freeze Fan and Walky Top Ride items now light up when you receive them - they previously never did
Fixed the Top Ride item-count checks showing as in logic on seeds that gate only Top Ride items
Removed two icons that could never be obtained (grey Kirby and Party Bomb)
Added Compact layout and reworked item layout for small screens
Resized icons to 32px (City Trial Events at 48px in a 3x5 grid)
Added Attack Up, Candy, Defense Up, No Charge, Run Amok, Speed Up to Special Offense
New event icons: Dyna Blade, Tac, Rails on Fire, Dense Fog, Air Ride Formation, Box Bounce, Same Items, Lighthouse
Secret Chamber and Lighthouse now show open/closed (lit/unlit) states
Added sparkles to the Restoration Area icon
Added in-tracker update checking
